name: Google Cloud SQL
description: The Sumo Logic app for Google Cloud SQL helps you monitor your usage of Google Cloud SQL. The preconfigured dashboards provide insight into created and deleted resources, messages, authorization failures, user activities, and error logs.

children.name: Google Cloud SQL - Activity
children.description: See information about actions, messages,  operations, created and deleted resources in Google Cloud SQL.

panels.name: Actions
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/sql data "type":"cloudsql_database" methodName
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload.methodName" as labels, method
| json field=labels "database_id", "project_id", "region" as instance, project, region
| count as executions by method
| sort by executions

panels.name: Actions Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/sql data "type":"cloudsql_database" methodName
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json  "message.data.protoPayload.methodName" as method
| json  "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.resource.labels.project_id", "message.data.resource.labels.database_id", "message.data.resource.labels.region" as labels, project, instance, region
| timeslice 1h
| count as changes by _timeslice, method
| transpose row _timeslice column method

| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload.methodName" as labels, method
| json field=labels "database_id", "project_id", "region" as instance, project, region
| timeslice 1h
| count as operations by _timeslice, instance
| transpose row _timeslice column instance

panels.name: Created Resources Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/sql data "type":"cloudsql_database" methodName
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload.methodName" as labels, method
| json field=labels "database_id", "project_id", "region" as instance, project, region
| json "message.data.protoPayload.authorizationInfo[*]" as permissions

panels.name: Deleted Resources Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/sql data "type":"cloudsql_database" methodName
| json "message.data" as data
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload.methodName" as labels, method
| json field=labels "database_id", "project_id", "region" as instance, project, region
| json "message.data.protoPayload.authorizationInfo[*]" as permissions
| parse regex field=permissions "\"permission\":\"(?<resource_type>[^\"]+)\.(?<method>[^\"]+?)\"" multi
| where method = "delete"
| timeslice 1h
| count as creations by _timeslice, resource_type
| transpose row _timeslice column resource_type

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/sql authorizationInfo callerIp logName principalEmail resource timestamp "\"type\":\"cloudsql_database\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload", "message.data.timestamp" as labels, payload, timestamp
| json field=labels "database_id", "project_id", "region" as instance, project, region
| json field=payload "authenticationInfo.principalEmail", "requestMetadata.callerIp", "authorizationInfo[*]" as user, caller_ip, permissions
| where !isNull(permissions)
| parse regex field=permissions "\"permission\":\"(?<action>[a-zA-Z\.]+)\",\"granted\":(?<granted>[a-z]+)}" multi
| where granted != "true"
| lookup country_name, city from geo://location on ip=caller_ip
| count as operations by timestamp, user, action, instance, country_name, city, caller_ip
| fields timestamp, user, action, instance, country_name, city, caller_ip
| sort by timestamp

children.name: Google Cloud SQL - Common Error Log Messages

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/sql logName textPayload "\"type\":\"cloudsql_database\"" ("\"severity\":\"WARNING\"" or "\"severity\":\"ERROR\"" or "\"severity\":\"CRITICAL\"" or "\"severity\":\"ALERT\"" or "\"severity\":\"EMERGENCY\"")
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.textPayload" as labels, text
| json field=labels "database_id", "project_id", "region" as instance, project, region
| logreduce(text) by instance
| signature as summarized_error
| _count as occurrences
| fields occurrences, instance, summarized_error
| sort by occurrences

children.description: See an overview of activity in Google Cloud SQL, including activity locations, created and deleted resources, operations by resources, authorization failures, and messages over time by severity.

panels.name: Location of Activity
panels.queryString:

| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload" as labels, payload
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp" as labels, caller_ip
| json field=payload "authenticationInfo.principalEmail", "authorizationInfo[*]" as user, permissions

children.name: Google Cloud SQL - Users
children.description: See information about your Google Cloud SQL users, including user locations; user activities over time and user activity outliers; top 10 users by messages; and resource creations and deletions by user.

panels.name: Location of Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/sql data resource labels callerIp principalEmail "\"type\":\"cloudsql_database\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "database_id", "project_id", "region" as instance, project, region
| json field=payload "requestMetadata.callerIp", "authenticationInfo.principalEmail" as caller_ip, user
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip=caller_ip
| count_distinct(user) by latitude, longitude, user

panels.name: User Activities Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/sql data logName resource timestamp principalEmail "\"type\":\"cloudsql_database\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail" as labels, user
| json field=labels "database_id", "project_id", "region" as instance, project, region
| timeslice 1h
| count as messages by _timeslice, user
| transpose row _timeslice column user

panels.name: User Activity - Outliers
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/sql data logName resource timestamp principalEmail "\"type\":\"cloudsql_database\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/*"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail" as labels, user
| json field=labels "database_id", "project_id", "region" as instance, project, region
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, user
| outlier _count by user
| fields _timeslice,user, _count_violation
| transpose row _timeslice column user
